caption:
Oggi a Parigi al Congresso dello YES - organizzazione dei giovani socialisti europei! Buon lavoro a tutte e tutti!

@yesocialists
text: They are not unbeatable. They are strong, but they are not unbeatable. Our recent history has already shown that every time that we run after them, they grow stronger. We can beat them by forcing them on the most uncomfortable ground for them, which is social justice. So we need to revert their narrative. Meloni's most famous speech was, I'm a woman, I'm a mother, I'm a Christian. And I say, good for you. But how does this help Italians who can pay their bills in the country with the highest cost of energy? How does this help Italians who earn less than 9 euros per hour in a country that has between the lowest wages of Europe? How does discriminating trans athletes in the sports is helping Americans pay their rent? Then I see room there to build our alternative by speaking of the everyday problems of our citizens. So we must not leave internationalism to the nationalists. We must build our progressive alternative, strengthening each other and strengthening our network. And we need you to do this. So I just conclude by saying, don't you ever wait for any kind of permission. By the way, generally, it doesn't come. So take the space you want. Take the space you need in our parties, in our organization, and keep fighting. Be the change that you want to see in the world and in our organization as well. So have a good Congress. And good luck to the new President and Secretary General that will be elected tomorrow. Thank you. Thank you.
